text:
If there is one thing I have learned in my years as a seamstress, $p, it is the importance of practice.

Always be practicing your craft, even when you believe you have mastered everything. I want you to be able to weave with excellence without my supervision.

Why don't you practice this week? Make a few Wildercloth Bolts at the highest quality.
The Keeper's Favor
Is that the new powder Flynn was talking about?\n\nI'll take it for safekeeping.

The eyes have shown me supplies, in Ardenweald. Hidden in the boughs, hidden from us, but they cannot hide from the eyes.

They do not use it, not as we would. We must use it. It is ours to take.

Kshhhh... bring it to us, the shaped wood. Many uses, very magical. Holds magic as a pitcher holds slime, fills with it.

Need it for our sorcerers. Cannot win in battle without our magic. Must win, no other way.

You have proven yourself worthy of the title of champion, <name>. You will compete at the tournament's highest level, riding in the grand melee and crushing the competition under the banner of the Thunder Bluff.
Tracking: Mill Treasure 4
The Judgment of Tyr
Drive back the N'Zoth Assault in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
I appreciate your help, <name>.  It pains me to see the spirits of my ancestors in their pitiful state.  May they finally get the rest they deserve.

Reth'hedron now lords over the Twilight Ridge of Nagrand. An eredar of such power being loosed upon this world does not bode well for the Illidari. Alas, we do not have the resources required to slay Reth'hedron. Not with the war the Sha'tar have brought to the Black Temple. No... I have a better plan.$B$BYou will subdue Reth'hedron, banishing him back through the Twilight Portal. For this a soul cannon must be fashioned.$B$BReturn to me with the materials on this list.
Demon Hunter Choice 2
Death Becomes Him

His own key?  That's incredible!\n\nI do not sense any disturbances in our timeline, so I suppose it was meant to occur all along.  There's no turning back now, <name>.  The key is yours and only yours.
I am relieved that the attack was repelled... but it seems we will need to figure out a plan to help Kalecgos in the Azure Archives.
Hui's Vengeance
Couldn't say what those spores were for, but I feel better knowin' they're gone.
Slay Managazer, the Basilisk Lord.
Obtain the Dreamwisp of Entangled Memories from the Headteacher in Algeth'ar Academy.
Escape Velocity

<The Swordmistress does not look well. There's a darkness to her eyes uncharacteristic of the pandaren.>$b$bI don't think I've ever been as... as furious as now. What betrayal!$b$bI fought them off when they attacked, killed a few here, but Merchant Shi is too much of a coward to let me go and finish the job!$b$bYou, do it for me. Kill them. Kill them all.
Vignette: Pale Gone Fishin'
How's the wood processing going? You should see what that thing does to broccoli!
A stack of ten thick yeti hides will net you a choice of one of my crafted items.  Because I care about quality, I am able to ensure you'll get a good item!
Cross the breach with Xandria.

We have reports dat Telaamon,  de Lightforged in charge of dis attack, can create mirror images of himself to strike us down.

Two Zandalari, Witch Doctor Kejabu and Jo'chunga, have offered to go in and help fight his mirror images. 

I want you to ensure dey survive.

Eliminating dese strange images should make Telaamon weaker, allowing you and Rokhan to slay him.
Summons from the Matriarch

Alright, so, we're goin' after the Alliance through this crazy fog. We gotta retake Zo'bal ruins up ahead.

We can do that real easy if we fix up our mech, A.F.M.O.D. - a flying mech of death! 

The Alliance wrecked it in their initial attack and took a bunch of its parts. Get those parts back and we'll have this thing fixed in no time!
<The runestone begins to vibrate as you approach, rune in hand.>
Plant the Horde Banner to Claim the Land.
Talk with Gazlowe, then go to Undermine using the rocket drill.
Return to the Seat of the Primus.
It's a sturdy rake.
Obtain 25 Unbruised Yak Haunches.
Fire in the Hole
I've been on my feet all day. You'd be surprised how busy this place gets.
Well done, <name>.  I will deliver these to Tyrosus when we return.

You've done a fine job here, $p.

With the city secure and Jaina in command of the fleet, the time has come for Kul Tiras to formally join the Alliance.

King Anduin has already departed for Unity Square to meet with Jaina, Katherine and the heads of the major Kul Tiran houses.

They are waiting for you.
I knew there was something familiar about that voidling. \n\nBut now that we have him cornered, he can tell us what we need to know.
The Maelstrom Pillar: Air
Hero's Call: Arathi Highlands!
Payback

A fine enough job, for one of your... ilk.

If you wish to keep breathing, I suggest you continue to assist us. It may even prove lucrative for you, if you comply.

Rak-Ush's former master allowed the stagshells to run feral, and abandoned the hollows to decay. Over time, invasive plants have infested the old stagshell hollows.

Find a way to clear them. I don't care how.
Candy buckets like this are located in inns throughout the realms. Go ahead... take some!

Outlander. Your aid is requested. 

The earthen here have said you would be of help. 

Our fellow earthen at the Opalcreg have not reported their quota for the past day. There must be something causing a disruption.  

Would you pay Foreman Alvegar a visit?

As fun as killing demons might be, it does us little good when the Legion can keep using its teleporters to replace anything we kill.$B$BUnfortunately, I don't have any high-powered explosives handy... but the mo'arg that maintain the teleporters do.$B$BTake this rod... I've tuned its powers to interfere with mo'arg brain frequencies.  Return to Forge Base: Gehenna and use it on any mo'arg you see.  You won't have long, but you'll be able to use their demolition charges on the nearby teleporters.

These Primalists are summoning an army of elementals. We have to assume they mean to unleash them against our forces.

Well, not on our watch.

Rain fire upon them, evoker! Burn those elementals from the Reach, and take out their conjurers before they summon more.

The vast rocky area to the southeast, Giants' Run, has been overrun by Iron Dwarves. Scouts have reported seeing the dwarves coaxing stone giants from the ground, then carving runes on them.$B$BI can't fathom their motives, but I suspect they're somehow trying to turn the giants into weapons. The iron rune stonecallers and binders carry large tomes with them, which must contain the runes they're carving on the giants.$B$BCapture the pieces of this book, assemble them, and bring it back to me, $n.
Legion Season 1 and 2 - Gladiator's Ironskin Armor
Kill Hunter Bonetusk, Roogug, and Warlord Ramtusk.
Broker's Bounty: Grimtalon
Thank you for coming to assist us.
Have at it, <name>. Make your choice.
Speak to Snagglebolt to enter the Crown Chemical Co. battle and defeat Apothecary Hummel.

I hope Gryan knows I withdrew my men from Thor Modan when the battle began. There's no way we can excavate anything until that place settles down.$B$BYou seem like a brave sort, though, and you have Stoutmantle's trust.$B$BThor Modan is just to the northeast of us and the battle still rages between our Earthen brothers and the creations of those accursed iron dwarves. Help our brethren to even the odds and I'll start figuring out how we're going to accomplish this survey of Thor Modan.
Potion Specialist
The tome carries the mark of the Athenaeum.

Yes... I begin to remember. Power. Power with a purpose. That is what I can offer.

Runes. Runes are the key. I've recalled some of them, but to infuse them into your equipment, I require my hands.

Well, one hand would suffice. Both would be better.

Find a way to free me from my bonds, mortal. Then I can offer the power you seek. After that, freedom... and perhaps the downfall of the one who bound me.

The wind is restless here, $n. Ohn'ahra is reaching out. I must answer her call.\n\nI need reagents for my ritual: reeds from the riverbanks, feathers from the tails of mallards, and the heart of a salamanther. Gather these materials from the river so that I may heed her voice.

Lilian and I have been shadowing Raelas Firewind and have uncovered his plan. He has manipulated the Sisters of the Flame to bind spirits from the Dream to magical spirit stones.

With Raelas's blessing, these stones became powerful tools of corruption, allowing these fallen dryads to twist the Dream and its denizens.

We will start our purge with the dryads--they have the stones. Then we will end Raelas.

The hunt begins, $p.
Soup for the Soul
Well, what do you think? I think you'll find that even the Preservatory itself is quite the work of art in its own right... Though that does mean it will prove rather vexing to infiltrate.

Alright, Ken-Ken pretty sure he knows what wrong with pandaren! Got old, old hozen remedy that do the trick.$B$BNeed to mix honey, fish oil, and salt. Ken-Ken saw lots of beehives in the trees around town, and there must be fish left in the dry ponds.$B$BThat just leave salt... Mei might know where we can find some.
Kill 10 Firewing Defenders, 10 Firewing Bloodwarders, and 10 Firewing Warlocks. Then report back to Sergeant Chawni at Stonebreaker Camp in Terokkar Forest.

<The snapdragon seems to recognize you as you approach, its ear fins wiggling with anticipation. 

Not only has it grown bigger overnight, but its scales have changed to a seaweed-green color similar to the Kaja'cola-braised meat you fed it.

Between it's talons lie morsels of meaty rations it has stolen from nearby invading forces. The snapdragon looks at you expectantly.

Perhaps you can bring it more meaty rations by slaying the invading forces on the island.>
Razkazzar, Lord of Axes
Spread the word about Brewfest at the flags outside the auction house in the Valley of Strength, in the Valley of Honor, in the Valley of Wisdom and in the Valley of Spirits.
The Bleeding Ore

<Petrov looks deeply disturbed, breathing heavily and shifting his gaze nervously around the mine.>$B$BMy comrades... we must put their souls to rest!  I kill them and kill them but.. they just come back!$B$BI've had an idea for a while but I just don't have the heart to do it myself.$B$BMaybe you can do this for me?  Take this lantern and use its oil to burn their remains so they never get up again.$B$BI'll answer your questions later.  Help my friends first!
Not too much trouble, I hope. With these samples we should be able to figure out what they plan to do with the ore and the big bomb.
Collect 20 Shattered Relic Fragments from elementals in Golgrin's Reach.
Have you found all the rangers?

Look around in the pond for a clue about who this wrecked raft may belong to.A destroyed raft rests along the shoreline. Considering this is only a small pond, it is not clear as to how it ended up here, although looking at the trees tells you that the water level may not be constant.\n\nPerhaps a little exploration in the area might uncover more clues...
Meet with Toddy and Naleidea in the Explorer's tent at the Dragonscale Basecamp in the Waking Shores.
Recover 10 Stolen Goods.
To be honest, I hope a grouper ate the old charter.\n\nWait, then it might end up here anyway. Dang it!

Look... um... this is really embarrassing. I set down my sword for like ONE SECOND to gather some orbs, and a big sprite sprung out of nowhere, snatched it, and bounded off down the western gap.$B$BI can't go back to camp without it. Losing your weapon is a sure way to get kicked out of the Shado-Pan. It's sacred.$B$BPlease, can you try to find this big sprite and get my sword back? It would mean a lot to me.
To the Deeps
Fly through the checkpoint rings marking the course.

The Qiraji and their servants wield items made with the rarest and finest materials: bones from gargantuan ancient creatures, gems from the depths of the earth, metals pure and strong.$B$BJust the sight of Qiraji artifacts fills me with an urge to practice my craft with their shattered and smelted pieces.  Prove your allegiance to the Circle, $n, and I will make you a powerful weapon from the finest Qiraji materials.

Our last hope of victory lies in defeating the val'kyr.  You've done well up until now... but you're only one $g man: woman; and there are literally dozens of them raining destruction on the battlefield.$b$bOne enormous val'kyr sits atop the tower to our south... you can see her from here.  Perhaps if we eliminate her, the remaining val'kyr will dissipate.$b$bThis is our only hope.  Bring some of Grant's men with you.  You'll need their protection for this battle.
I will fight for dem until dey are free.
Decor Treasure Hunt

Ah, fine specimens, <name>. The two pieces you've found should be perfect for baiting Lar'korwi into the open. I cannot wait to see the outcome of your fight with the monster. He is a massive thing with claws as sharp as the finest blades. You will look into his eyes and you will know death.
Krasarang RRP - Daily Vignette - Warrior Boss

Having Derek Proudmoore's body in our possession is a greater boon than we had planned for.

Valentine is risen, but I think it best to allow Derek to lay dead for a bit longer.

It's time to use our new allies to our advantage.
Rocket Rescue

Take the Enchanted Naga Missive to someone in Silvermoon City.
 Speak to a Mage in Silvermoon about the Enchanted Scroll (1)




Provided item: 

Enchanted Naga Scroll (1)

Mastery Of The Shield-Breaker
Our forces stand ready.\n\nLet us end this.

Now, onward to the Stormstout Brewery! It's high time that I was reunited with the rest of the Stormstouts... and what better way to reunite than over a few mugs of ale?$b$bYou know where the brewery is, right? Just follow this road to the west. You can't miss it. Of course, you're free to share the road with us - we'll be leaving any moment now.
There are some exciting orders to fill this week! The students at Algeth'ar Academy have been going horns over heels for these fun scepters.\n\nWhy don't you assist with some of the scepters?
Clean Up
Candy Bucket

De loa have reunited with us forest trolls, and de land reacts with glorious bounty!

Do ya wish to take part? Then go north, and meet me at de entrance to Loaknit Den.

There I will introduce ya to prosperity and plentitude like ya never seen...
Khadgar
Akazamzarak 1 Week Cooldown
So many choices, so little time!$b$bGood luck out there, $n... but I don't think you'll need it.
Slay 6 Crazed Diggers and Mekgineer Mixeltweed.
Fly through the checkpoint rings marking the course.
Gather 5 Coarse Leather Barding for Charlane in Boralus Harbor.
Travel to Silithus and search for a Reliquary of Purity within the ruins of Southwind Village. If you are able to find it, return with it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.
The Klaxxi
Farming is thirsty work, and I'm always looking for refreshing spring water.\n\nIf you have any, then I'm willing to make a trade.
At the stream below rests a single lotus flower. Within this lotus lies a sign of things to come. Bring it to me that I might show you.

These look a little worse for wear, but they're still edible. The crusaders will be glad to hear that we've had some success. Maybe we can give the half-eaten ones to the Silver Covenant. That would make my day.
A Call to Ardenweald
If you are able to heal the plant, it will again begin to grow. We must do what we can, $N...
Travel to the Maw and rescue Lost Souls from the Tremaculum and the Planes of Torment.
Open the Adventuring Letter.

For years I have sought a certain gem.  It is called the Heart of the Mountain and it's the size of your fist!  The Dark Iron dwarves have it locked in their vault and, try as I may, they won't let me purchase it.$B$BSo I must resort to force.$B$BFight your way to The Black Vault near the Hall of Crafting, breach its secret safe and gain the Heart.  To do that, you must defeat Watchman Doomgrip, and he won't appear until you've opened every relic coffer in the vault!$B$BGood luck.
Rheanna at Blue Sky Logging Grounds wants you to use the Renewing Bandage on 10 Wounded Westfall Infantry units.
A Place Forgotten
<Aethas inhales.> \n\nYes. This will do... for now.
Hundreds upon hundreds of pages filled with garbled text and symbols make up the brunt of this book.
Teach the Havoc specialization to your assembled demon hunters.
The Pylon table allows you to combine blue power crystals with yellow power crystals.\n\nAccording to J.D.'s manual, this combination can be used to create a shield that does damage to enemies.

According to the documents you salvaged from the caravan, the Venture Co. created many plans to attempt to drive us from our lands here, so that they could have free reign to plunder our lands.$b$bThe depths that they would sink to accomplish their goals disgusts and appalls me. I want the mastermind behind their plans killed. His name is Supervisor Fizsprocket, you will find him at the Venture Co. mine east of the ravaged caravan. Bring me his clipboard, we shall see if we find out anything useful.
Have you been to the Slag Mines yet?\n\nHonestly, who mines slag anyway? What do they do with it?

<The inscription promises to not only attract spirits, but to whip them into a violent frenzy if enough is burned. That can't end well.

Still, it does smell nice.

Sluggs probably knows something about this item.>
Though this wild boar meat is bland, simmer it enough in the right spices and it sure does make for some tasty pie!
I cannae believe that some folks don't care about history. Just makes me sad.

Gnomus knows about the massive diemetradon and plans to eat it! He must have been able to see what I could see through the eyes of his arcano-scorp. Look, there's no time to explain. He's crazy and that craziness is going to cost us the closest thing we've got to a fireproof jumpsuit.$B$BGet back to the lava flow near Baa'ri and track down Felspine the Greater. Once you find it, kill it and bring me back its hide.$B$BDon't try and reason with me, $n. I'm well past that point.
Azshara Blues

....mother?

...so cold...

...heading into the Twisting Nether...h-h-h-hold me mother....
Destroy 8 Binding Runes to free captive villagers.
Your cub still looks hungry. What's the hold up?
Old MacDonald
Doomshot
Fly through the checkpoint rings marking the course.
Meet Shandris Feathermoon outside of Zo'bal Ruins.

Ah, the Trial of Style is upon us, <class>. 

The outfits, the creativity, the elegance of the Trial are truly a sight to see.

Speak to a Trial of Style Envoy to learn more about the event.

A word of warning, those envoys can be... challenging to deal with.
Nice work <name>.  These samples will help us figure out what is going on in that toxic soup over there.
Unleash the Beast
WANTED: Pathaleon's Projector
Step One: The Priestess

Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 8 Frozen Runes, 16 Enchanted Leathers, 5 Essences of Water, 5 Cured Rugged Hides and 300 gold. You must also be of Exalted reputation with the Argent Dawn.

Inside the bottle you find a note which reads, in fairly good handwriting:$B$B<To any that can aid me->$B$B<Please, my need for help is dire. A great beast holds me captive on an island in the South Seas.>$B$B<The stars at night are foreign to me and obscured by the jungle trees, but on the clearest days I see shoreline to the northwest, and what seem to be large sailing ships to the southwest.>$B$B<I beg of you, my would-be savior, please help me.>

Your followers tell of a smuggler of wit and guile, who was able to charm them with stories of lands far and wide.\n\nThough it cost a fair sum to retrieve, they managed to obtain a token which when displayed to the smuggler, will allow the bearer to purchase his wares.
Know this, <name>. You did the only thing you could.\n\nWhen a mortal has become corrupted by the nightmare, there is no return. Only death will set them free.
Tracking: Mill Treasure 17
Meet the Sons of Lothar at Lothar's Statue.
Temple Throwdown
There's no need to hurry. But if you wouldn't mind hurrying anyway...

Thank you, <name>.

This was no easy task and I am grateful once again for your assistance. Iskar's madness must be stopped.

I trust that when the time comes you will be ready.

Along this road the merchants ride. Taking dere wares from one place to another and lining them own pockets. 

One Big Mon named Tik'su be the worst of all. He charge arms and legs outright and it even take trolls some time to regrow them parts.

His biggest pride? His hat. 

Go be my messenger, Rich-mon. Scare his burdened beast and knock off Tik'su. Then bring me his hat.

<A bite wound wrecks Hathvelion's forearm.>

Snapdragons... cruel creatures made to kill and feed. Their poison moves as you move. The naga bred the perfect pet.

I'm here on a tip from Lyssara Duskmourne. Sunsail Anchorage's shipping routes have been sabotaged by the naga, and those routes converge... here.

I intercepted a few shipments. Could you help me search them? My team is still out in the field, but they should report back soon.
WANTED: Siegemaster Aedrin
The first batch of toys is all ready to go!
Level 28
Deprecated: A Well Rounded Defense

Excellent work, $n! The rear is now officially clear. We'll take care of the stragglers. I want you to go back to Marshal McBride, standing in front of Northshire Abbey, south of here, and let him know that the goblin situation is under control.$B$BFarewell, $c.

The Focusing Iris has been stolen from the Dalaran Vaults! The thief was a mage of some skill, but we've been unable to track him.

Fortunately, the thief dropped a note from his master, addressing him as one of his "apprentici." I know of only one mage who uses that particular pluralization - Archmage Xylem.

I'll need you to investigate. In Azshara you will find his tower where he trains his apprentices. Go there, and see what Xylem is up to.

|cFF660000Specialization: Survival Hunter|r
Search for messages in Taelloch Mine.

Bodies, broken gear, uncontrolled titan energy. What a disregard for safety, and... and protocol! It looks like they found the stone and it was unstable, bursting into pieces.

Fortunately, I'm particularly adept at repairing magical devices.

But before I can reform the stone we need to collect each and every piece.

$n, are you ready for another gift?

The next boon we grant thee is one of bonds. As you have bound yourself to us, we shall bind to you. In the binding of souls, we become something greater.

<Moonberry leans in close.>

Sounds scary, huh? Don't worry! You and your soulbind will both strengthen each other.

When I asked for volunteers, many fae stepped forward. I picked someone I just know you're going to like. And this will be a boon for her, too.

Go to Flutterby. She'll help you both.
Looks like you made it in one piece.
Flickerwick Needs Help!

The wild sparrowhawks of Nagrand have the keenest sight of all the predatory birds here. But, because of their size, they've been pushed out of most areas by the larger windrocs.

Most of the sparrowhawks nest here, on the Twilight Ridge. If you can catch one, I'll train it to spot the pieces of your buried tablet.

It's going to be difficult, though. The sparrowhawks are very skittish and will flee at your approach. I'd suggest cornering one or prowling to get close enough to cast your net.Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
7.2 Class Hall - Maximillian of Northshire - Aqcuisition - Track Mail Sent
Bring your Band of Eternity to Soridormi at the Caverns of Time after obtaining Revered reputation with the Scale of the Sands.
<The murloc seems hungry. Next to it is a series of crude drawings which seems like a shopping list. Perhaps you can help the creature.>
Raelorasz wants you to use Raelorasz's Spear to subdue a Nexus Drake Hatchling and return it to him at the Transitus Shield.
Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
Botani Invasion!

Oh, bless ya, <name>, bless ya!\n\nJust set 'em down right where yer standin'. I'll have one o' the boys come load 'em up soon enough and we can stop worryin' 'bout runnin' out o' balls ta shoot at Skorn.
The Winterhoof Brave has asked you to use The Brave's Machete to dismember 20 Vrykul of the Winterskorn tribe at Skorn.
Escort A-Me 01 back to Karna Remtravel at Mossy Pile.
Arkethrax

Someone save me from all this bickering. Alliance this, Horde that... 

I've never encountered anything like it in my thousands of years even amongst the Oathsworn and Unbound. If they committed half the energy they expend on posturing towards training, our task would be complete by now.

See what help you can offer my people. They need real mentorship if we are to be ready for the next nerubian offensive.

The Zandalari have found a way to bind loa to their beasts giving them impressive and lethal powers.$b$bWe need to put a stop to this.$b$bSearch the Beast Pens for a loa speaker and slay him. You should be able to find them by keeping a look out for their glowing beasts.$b$bWe must not allow these atrocities to continue.
Strength of One

<The Korthian protector is gravely wounded and struggles to speak.>

Devourers... swarmed the sanctuary. Too few of us...

My duty... incomplete.

The Purpose... I...

<The protector's voice fades.>
Take your Sharptalon Hatchling to the Inn in Darnassus.
Vyrin's Revenge
An Extra Sticky Situation
Fire Plume Forged
The Old Ways

$n, it is good to see you again!

Following your success against the House of Constructs, Secutor Mevix is eager for more action on the battlefield.

Don't leave an eager soldier to wallow here. Give him purpose!
Prey: Anguish Island
Kill 6 Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen for Calor in Darkshire.

The scroll you brought back was left behind for me by my mentor, Ja'kul. I didn't even have a chance to read it before it was stolen away! \n\nJa'kul left directions in the scroll to a cave that's behind a waterfall in Blooming Lattice. I'm not sure what we'll find there, but I would really appreciate if you came along while I check it out. Will you meet me there?
You did it! You did it! My treasures! Take that, stupid Candleclaws.

Now to get some vital statistics. Ve'nari and her people have all sorts o' contraptions for doing things around here.

This li'l robot is gonna use the thing the snakes are on to take some measurements. Just speak with it when you're ready.

I can get readings for the rest o' the snakes while you're off doing other things.
Agogridon is no more.\n\nThe demons shall never again take hold in our lands!
The Mysterious Missive
You return, <name>.  Did you obtain the blood?
You can learn a lot on the battlefield on your own. Go ahead and see what you observe.
The Horde Needs Wool Bandages!
The naga of the Bloodscale Enclave to the northeast have begun to kill our people.  We cannot allow this to continue, $c!$B$BWe suggest that you teach them a lesson as proof of our friendship.

<Your followers have sent a report regarding the assault on Wolf's Den.

It details that victory was hard-fought, but all of the bandits previously living in the outpost have been slain.

Deliver the report to Nathanos Blightcaller aboard The Banshee's Wail.>
Antorus, the Burning Throne: Dark Passage
FLAG - Pest Problems Training

TBDTBDYou will receive:

Upon completion of this quest you will gain:
Honor the Flame

This arcan'dor is one of an ancient species. They were not bred, but created. In them the arcane and primitive druidic magics merged into something greater than both.

The arcane will soon devour it whole.

We can restore balance, but it will require wild magic. Magic trapped in another realm.

You must enter the Emerald Dreamway and bring back the essence of life itself.

Only then can the arcan'dor find stability and begin to thrive once more.
Glide through the rings.

These lands are vast--the terrain rises so much that it's easy for even the most knowledgeable tracker to get lost. If you want to help us out, you'll need a way to navigate. Take this compass, it should do the trick.
I'm impressed. Most students that are even capable of reaching this spot do so soaking wet.
Garrison Max-level Choice Tracker: Frostfire Iron Siegeworks

Many brave trolls have been lost to the harsh wilds of the Hinterlands, <race>. The Silvermane wolves are one of the biggest threats to our hunters. They lay in wait, hiding amongst the bushes and landscape, then strike out when the opportunity presents itself.

This type of ferocity will not go unchecked!

You must think like the Silvermane. Stalk the stalkers! Slay them all!
Resurrect the Expedition recruits.
I can't wait to show my friends! Now, just wait a moment while I attach these...$b$bPerfect!
Gather me wood planks from construction near the Ki-Han Brewery.$B$BYou do not yet know the extent of my strength, so I shall display it to you.
Champion: Chen Stormstout

Are you ready for today's challenge? I've hidden a piece from my collection here in the neighborhood. To find it, you must merely solve this simple riddle:

Arcane power thrums.
Journey home with a mere step.
Dig beside the roost.

Good luck!
Let us hope that distraction bought us the time we need to fully learn what we need of the training grounds at Karabor.
Turning Point

Well done, <name>. I will use the power of these charms to augment the magic that has already been gathered. When enough power has been amassed, I shall focus the collected energies and call upon the Forest Lord to aid our cause.
Kill 6 Vilebrood Skitterers in Stormglen.
